reviews.title: Best bang for your pfsense router buck! Don't think twice!
reviews.comment:
Bought this to turn it into a high power router for pfsense capable of routing 3gb PPPOE internet at full line speed with wireguard. It did not disappoint (providing you have the network infrastructure and tune all your settings). It is arguably the best computer on the market for this specialized purpose with 3 expansion slots and tiny footprint. The design internally for the 8x slot is terrible and doesn't give you much room at all to cool high temp SFP cards as it is pushing right up against the power supply. Not sure what kind of video card could fit here if that's what you wanted to add.
There are no extra wires to power fans and you will have to invest in the special Dell SATA header cable and then from SATA to 3pin cable to run fans. Messy but it works.
80mm fan fits in front to draw air in which is necessary otherwise there is ZERO airflow inside the case. The CPU has a hood that channels intake from the outside.
For me, I'll never buy another firewall product again and with internet getting faster all the time, those little appliances will never be able to touch the performance of a PC when it comes to routing it.

reviews.title: Very impressive dell slim desktop
reviews.comment:
I’ve been using my Dell desktop for a while now, and I have to say I’m really impressed. From the start, the setup was quick and easy, and the computer has been running smoothly ever since. The performance is excellent—it handles multitasking, streaming, and everyday work without slowing down.
One of the things I appreciate most is the reliability. It boots up fast, programs open quickly, and I don’t have to deal with constant glitches or lag. The design is sleek and compact, so it doesn’t take up too much space on my desk, and it runs quietly, which is a big plus.
Overall, I’m very happy with my Dell desktop and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a dependable, well-performing computer.
